create_BUNCH_DICT: create a Bunch object from a dictionary to enable dot-accessible attribute lookup on keys
convert_TO_BUNCH: convert a nested dictionary or list into dot-accessible Bunch objects recursively
merge_JSON_dicts: merge two JSON-compatible dictionaries or lists together, extending lists and combining dict keys
review_BUNCH_CLASS: review the Bunch class that extends dict to allow attribute-style access via dot notation
test_merge_json: test the merge_json function to verify it correctly merges nested dicts and extends lists
